cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Most cash is RMB cash at group level and the annual report does not split parent/offshore/PRC subsidiary balances; use the conservative China-subsidiary/group-cash haircut range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Unpledged cash and bank balances excluding pledged deposits and original-maturity-over-one-year time deposit.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-pledged but original maturity exceeds one year and was made for three years when acquired; use low end of long-term deposit haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially detachable or usable for future debt service after maturity, but not immediately equivalent to operating cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Pledged deposits are not freely detachable.
cash_breakdown.reason: RMB15.320 million secured letters of credit and RMB2.512 million was pledged to local government for timely development of leasehold land.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank debt is deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Includes RMB20.000 million unsecured current bank loan and RMB24.708 million secured non-current bank loan.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserved rather than treated as detachable because goods distribution requires inventory, receivables, supplier settlement and cash-flow buffer.
cash_breakdown.reason: Estimated at roughly one month of cost of sales plus operating expenses, rounded conservatively below the 2023 monthly cost base because pledged deposits and working capital are considered separately.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Small explicit reserve for extracting RMB cash through dividends, FX conversion or debt repayment paths.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash is not split by legal entity and RMB is not freely convertible; the annual report notes RMB conversion is subject to mainland foreign exchange administration.

profit_quality.assessment: Use RMB35.000 million as pre-haircut distributable cash profit, then apply a 0.65 cash-profit haircut. The base is below the 2021-2023 median parent net profit of RMB47.662 million because revenue and gross profit declined, 2023 reported profit was only RMB20.257 million, and cash conversion is uneven.
adjustments: 2021-2023 parent net profit was RMB86.061 million, RMB47.662 million and RMB20.257 million.

2021-2023 operating cash flow was RMB-15.282 million, RMB94.360 million and RMB50.946 million; the three-year OCF/net profit ratio using totals was about 1.07 but depended heavily on working-capital swings.

2023 PPE purchases were RMB57.634 million, far above 2021-2022, so ordinary maintenance capex was estimated at RMB2.500 million and expansion/construction spend was reflected in the profit haircut rather than fully annualised as maintenance.
RMB11.031 million impairment on trade receivables in 2023 indicates receivable quality risk; it supports a lower cash-profit haircut rather than simple add-back.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Positive 2022-2023 operating cash flow supports a non-null denominator, but 2021 negative OCF, 2023 receivable impairment and construction cash outflow keep the discount at 0.65.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Distribution business cash generation exists, but three-year quality is volatile and part of earnings was tied to working-capital release, associate profit, interest income and receivable impairment.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year aggregate OCF divided by aggregate parent net profit is approximately 1.07, but the year-to-year pattern is uneven.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex; 2023 large PPE purchase appears construction-related, so the main numerator uses estimated maintenance capex and a lower profit haircut.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Payment terms of 30-90 days and 2023 receivable impairment require an explicit cash-profit haircut.
